sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Special G.R. Case No.19 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Adhoc Addl. District and Sessions Judge (POCSO), Fast Track Spl. Court, Rourkela arising out of Lathikanta P.S. Case No.19 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 420/384/376(2)(n)/506 of IPC, Section 6/15 of POCSO Act and U/s.66D/66E of the I.T. Act.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge (POCSO), Fast Track Spl. Court, Rourkela
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Ad-hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC),
(POCSO), Rourkela by order dated 07.08.2024 in the aforementioned cases, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 12.02.2024 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 31.03.2024, Petitioner may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.

sentences.text: Considering the same and filing of charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

9. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.

10. It is further directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the victim and/or her family member.
11.
It shall be open to the prosecution as well as victim to seek variance of this order, in case there is any threat perception.
12. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Designation: Senior Stenographer
